name: llama-70b-cxl-overcommit
description: Four compute nodes serving Llama-3-70B under local DRAM pressure with a shared CXL-attached memory pool. Sized to overcommit local DRAM (16 GiB local tier vs ~22.5 GiB active KV working set) to exercise remote memory, page spill, eviction, and fabric utilization.
assumptions: Local DRAM capacity is deliberately constrained to 16 GiB per node (down from 512 GiB) to evaluate disaggregated memory tiering under local memory pressure.
Each compute-to-pool link is modeled as an independent byte server; shared pool service contention is not yet modeled in this revision.
The workload is synthetic KV-cache decode derived from Llama-3-70B geometry (320 KiB per token).
Results allow controlled comparison between swap-to-remote and frequency-aware placement policies under identical workloads and seeds.
